notes: Primary source is Microsoft's official 85" model tech-spec page (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/surface-hub/surface-hub-2s-85), cross-checked against the general Surface Hub 2S tech-specs page. Port list per Microsoft: USB-A, Mini-DisplayPort 1.2 video output, RJ45 gigabit Ethernet, HDMI video input (HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.2/1.4), USB-C with DisplayPort input, and (3) additional USB-C ports on the display bezel/top (one of which is used for the included Surface Hub 2S Camera, 4K, USB-C connection). Total USB-C count = 4, matching third-party retailer summaries. USB-A port count/direction not specified by Microsoft (listed simply as "USB-A", singular, direction assumed host/output per typical peripheral-connection use, though these can also serve as bidirectional host ports for storage). Power inlet: Microsoft does not explicitly name the IEC connector type; the unit ships with a detachable 4m AC power cable (per quick-start guide) and draws 665W operating / 745W surge / 7.8A at 90-265V — parameters consistent with a standard IEC C13/C14 inlet (rated to 10A/250V, common on large commercial displays in this power class), so iec was used as the best-fit id; this is an inference, not manufacturer-confirmed, hence medium confidence overall. No SDI, XLR, or analog audio ports are present on this model (audio is fixed-mount speaker/mic arrays, not exposed as external jacks). Not rack-mountable (wall/cart-mounted flat panel; rackUnits omitted). HDMI grade taken directly from spec ("HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.2/1.4"). Mini-DisplayPort output version explicitly stated as 1.2 by Microsoft. USB-C ports' USB speed generation is not stated by Microsoft, so grade was omitted for those to avoid guessing; the "USB-C with DisplayPort Input" port also carries DP video alt-mode functionality but grade reflects USB-C's data role only omitted per source silence — video routing capability noted in port name instead.
